Prince Andrew faces potential stripping of City of London honour

Prince Andrew is reportedly a step closer to being stripped of the Freedom of the City of London honour. The City of London Corporation has been granted powers to remove the honour. This action is being treated as a "matter of urgency". The Duke of York was previously stripped of his military titles and royal patronages.
